usedFor: Cakemail holds email campaigns and contacts, and Algodocs receives a file by URL through “Upload Document”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Campaign” in Cakemail, then “Upload Document” in Algodocs
bestTemplate.why: Campaign creation is a clear point to file a document, and the action takes it from a URL.

watchOut: “Campaign Updated” in Cakemail fires on every edit, so one campaign can upload a document more than once.
